title: Save the native GA4 Growth dashboard and configure verified signup and lead key events

source.ref: Owner request to build a saved dashboard inside hello@frequencylocal.com Google Analytics, separate from Frequency reporting code.

detail: Frequency property 539919559 has working read-only Data API reporting under frequency-analytics@frequency-web.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Fresh Admin inspection on 2026-11-15 UTC finds sign_up and generate_lead key-event definitions absent and purchase present. An earlier explicitly analytics.edit-scoped authorized sign_up creation returned 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; no setting changed, and no new write was retried. The currently available reporting adapter is intentionally analytics.readonly and current writable property access is not asserted. Native saved overview/Library collection authoring is not exposed by the available reporting/Admin discovery methods, and this cloud thread has no callable authenticated Chrome/browser-control tools for the requested hello@frequencylocal.com session. Reading real reports and exporting a JSON specification do not create a native saved dashboard. Finish through an authorized Editor session or securely connected supported account setup: save the native Growth overview/collection covering acquisition, campaigns, landing pages, engagement and verified conversion outcomes; configure sign_up and generate_lead as appropriate key events while preserving purchase. Do not send wellness content, personal data or synthetic conversions to Google. This row remains OPEN until an actual saved report/collection link and fresh key-event readback establish completion. Site dashboard work and its source probes cannot close this manual account task. The browser-enabled operator handoff is /workspace/shared/FREQUENCY-GA4-GROWTH-HANDOFF.md; it requires inspect-before-create, an actual saved report link and key-event readback.

verify.evidence: Fresh read-only account audit google2303-readonly-audit.json: property 539919559 reports and Admin keyEvents GET return 200; sign_up=false, generate_lead=false, purchase=true. Prior authorized create returned 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, receipt ga4-key-event-setup-2026-11-14.json. No native saved overview or Library collection was created or verified, and no authenticated browser-control tool is callable here. Completion needs a real native dashboard link plus key-event readback; current source tests are not remote account proof.
